sources.title: Approved Methodologies under Offset Mechanism

methodologies.name: Energy efficiency and fuel switching measures for industrial facilities
Hydrogen production using methane extracted from biogas
Flaring or use of landfill gas
Methane recovery from livestock and manure management at households and small farms
Emission reduction through improved management practices in rice cultivation
limitations: Do not infer that all crop-residue burning avoidance is eligible; confirm the methodology's applicability conditions and full current version.

methodologies.name: Production of Compressed Bio-gas (CBG)
limitations: Biomass feedstock origin and stubble-burning avoidance eligibility must be explicitly covered by the methodology and approved project documents.

methodologies.name: Electricity and Heat Generation from Biomass
limitations: Biomass feedstock and baseline fuel displacement must meet the full methodology; residue collection alone does not establish credits.
Retrieve and apply the full methodology and current version before eligibility decisions.
